scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @causality/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @causality/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts test && pnpm --filter @causality/api test && pnpm --filter @causality/web test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts build && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://causality:causality@127.0.0.1:5432/causality pnpm db:migrate && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://causality:causality@127.0.0.1:5432/causality pnpm db:seed && playwright test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts build && pnpm --filter @causality/api build && pnpm --filter @causality/web build
